content.text:
Jessica Lawton travels to Reuben Tracy’s mother’s farm, rescues him for the threatened Minster estate, steals Gedney’s affidavits, and leaves the mob at the Minster house. Reuben pacifies the crowd, then learns Jessica has collapsed at General Boyce’s house; dying, she reconciles Horace and Reuben and reveals their child.

Other tales follow Cissy Trixit fleeing her seized Canada City home to find her fugitive father, and Masterton pursuing her through the Sierras. At a fonda, Cota’s horse attacks men, inspiring a ghost legend. On Eureka Mountain, Eugenia falls onto Bray, whose companions discover gold; “Jack” and “Jill” reunite in San Francisco. Miss Trotter’s hotel career and Chris Calton’s failed engagement lead to their love. Lester Kane takes Jennie from Cleveland to New York and Chicago, concealing her daughter Vesta.
